name: Island Wing Company
description: Island Wing Company is a full-service casual dining restaurant and bar specializing in crispy chicken wings and tenders served alongside eclectic takes on burgers, tacos, mac and cheese and more. With a lively atmosphere perfect for friends and family, we offer an extensive menu of food and drinks including a large draft beer list, frozen drinks, and cocktails. Enjoy Island Time while watching the latest game, enjoying live music, or catching up with loved ones.
